place.name: Skuleberget
place.description: Skuleberget is a mountain on the west side of the E4 motorway a few kilometers north of Docksta in Kramfors municipality in Ångermanland (Västernorrland County), Sweden. Skuleberget is near, but not part of the Skuleskogen National Park, as the national park is on the east side of the E4.
